issues.description: Uses prompt() to collect user input for coins and tokens, then updates DOM element with these values. No input validation beyond isNaN check; however, values are not inserted via innerHTML, only textContent.
issues.recommendation: Consider stricter input validation and ensure only numeric values are used. Using textContent mitigates XSS risk.

issues.description: Script attempts to simulate adding coins/tokens by updating the DOM. No actual interaction with Blooket API or server.
issues.recommendation: No sensitive actions detected. If future versions add network requests, review for data exfiltration.

summary: This UserScript does not transmit data externally, does not collect sensitive information, and does not execute remote code. It only updates the DOM based on user input and logs actions locally. No critical or high risks detected. Minor input validation and DOM update concerns, but overall the script is safe.
